content: The general framework defined above was inspired largely by the open-source code of Nag Dev, and was built using Pytorch [7]. One key extension to the basic GAN model, however, is the loss function that we apply to the generator, namely the Diehl-Martinez-Kamalu (DMK) Loss which we define below.
